Two-choice physical commonsense questions testing practical knowledge of objects, tools, and everyday actions.
Exact-answer general-knowledge clues drawn from literature, history, word origins, and science categories.

Short passages followed by yes-or-no reading-comprehension questions scored as multiple choice.
Book passages requiring exact prediction of the final word from the preceding context.

Few-shot selection of the most plausible continuation for an everyday scenario.
